With a location within a 6-km distance of the bustling Hanoi Night Market, the hotel also features 9 golf courses. This Hanoi hotel in Tay Ho, which is home to most of the city's long term expats, from embassy staff to English teachers-in addition to a lot of well-to-do Vietnamese families is nearly a 10-minute ride from the President Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum and nearly a 15-minute ride from such shopping venues as Ba Dinh Historic Square. Places of worship to visit 3.8 km from the affordable L7 West Lake Hanoi By Lotte Hotels include the buddhist temple "Tran Quoc Pagoda". Families travelling to Hanoi will enjoy being approximately a 20-minute drive from the Thống Nhất Park. The nearest bus stop is Tru so Quan uy Tay Ho, located only 0.6 km away, and Ha Noi train station is around 7 km away. The rooms at L7 West Lake Hanoi By Lotte Hotels are fitted with an air conditioner as well as a mini fridge bar. These immaculate rooms also come with private bathrooms, equipped with a bidet, a separate toilet, and a shower. The separate bedrooms feature a wardrobe. Bathrooms include a bidet, a separate toilet, and a shower, along with comforts such as a hair dryer and a shower cap. In the L7 West Lake Hanoi By Lotte Hotels you will be treated to a delightful American breakfast daily. Layered restaurant looks out onto the city and specialises in vegan cuisine. Guests can relax at the on-site rooftop bar.
